channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-48356 — Adobe Commerce and Magento
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

item.title: CVE-2026-111357 — Ivanti Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

item.title: CVE-2026-111497 — Google Brotli
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

item.title: CVE-2026-50751 — Check Point Security Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Check Point Security Gateway contains an improper authentication vulnerability in IKEv1 key exchange that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass user authentication and establish a remote access VPN connection without a valid user password.

item.title: CVE-2024-1708 — ConnectWise ScreenConnect
item.description: Threat Signal 88. ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow an attacker to execute remote code or directly impact confidential data and critical systems.

item.title: CVE-2025-49704 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-49706. CVE-2025-53770 is a patch bypass for CVE-2025-49704, and the updates for CVE-2025-53770 include more robust protection than those for CVE-2025-49704.

item.title: CVE-2025-0282 — Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways contain a stack-based buffer overflow which can lead to unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-40711 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Veeam Backup and Replication contains a deserialization vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-0618 — Microsoft SQL Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services contains a deserialization vulnerability when handling page requests incorrectly. An authenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the Report Server service account.

item.title: CVE-2024-21887 — Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure) and Ivanti Policy Secure contain a command injection vulnerability in the web components of these products, which can allow an authenticated administrator to send crafted requests to execute code on affected appliances. This vulnerability can be leveraged in conjunction with CVE-2023-46805, an authenticated bypass issue.

item.title: CVE-2023-41265 — Qlik Sense
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

item.title: CVE-2021-45046 — Apache Log4j2
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Apache Log4j2 contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability due to the incomplete fix of CVE-2021-44228, where the Thread Context Lookup Pattern is vulnerable to remote code execution in certain non-default configurations.

item.title: CVE-2022-41040 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft Exchange Server allows for server-side request forgery. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082 which allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-26352 — dotCMS dotCMS
item.description: Threat Signal 88. dotCMS ContentResource API contains an unrestricted upload of file with a dangerous type vulnerability that allows for directory traversal, in which the file is saved outside of the intended storage location. Exploitation allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-37042 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in MailboxImportServlet. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-27925 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-7195 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 88. QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

item.title: CVE-2019-7192 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 88. QNAP NAS devices running Photo Station contain an improper access control vulnerability allowing remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the system.

item.title: CVE-2018-11138 — Quest KACE System Management Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 88. The '/common/download_agent_installer.php' script in the Quest KACE System Management Appliance is accessible by anonymous users and can be abused to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-0144 — Microsoft SMBv1
item.description: Threat Signal 88. The SMBv1 server in multiple Microsoft Windows versions allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

item.title: CVE-2017-12149 — Red Hat JBoss Application Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. The JBoss Application Server, shipped with Red Hat Enterprise Application Platform 5.2, allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted serialized data.

item.title: CVE-2021-40438 — Apache Apache
item.description: Threat Signal 88. A crafted request uri-path can cause mod_proxy to forward the request to an origin server choosen by the remote user. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server 2.4.48 and earlier.

item.title: CVE-2021-34523 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2020-0688 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft Exchange Server Validation Key fails to properly create unique keys at install time, allowing for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-34473 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-34527 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability due to the Windows Print Spooler service improperly performing privileged file operations. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to perform remote code execution with SYSTEM privileges. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of PrintNightmare.

item.title: CVE-2021-40444 — Microsoft MSHTML
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft MSHTML contains a unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2012-0158 — Microsoft MSCOMCTL.OCX
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft MSCOMCTL.OCX contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution, allowing an attacker to take complete control of an affected system under the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2021-26855 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

item.title: CVE-2021-35211 — SolarWinds Serv-U
item.description: Threat Signal 88. SolarWinds Serv-U contains an unspecified memory escape vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-20021 — SonicWall SonicWall Email Security
item.description: Threat Signal 88. SonicWall Email Security contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an attacker to create an administrative account by sending a crafted HTTP request to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20022 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2015-3306 — ProFTPD ProFTPD
item.description: Threat Signal 87. ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-0257 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass security restrictions and establish an unauthorized VPN connection.

item.title: CVE-2024-27199 — JetBrains TeamCity
item.description: Threat Signal 87. JetBrains TeamCity contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow limited admin actions to be performed.

item.title: CVE-2024-41713 — Mitel MiCollab
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Mitel MiCollab contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized and unauthenticated access. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2024-55550, which allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read arbitrary files on the server.

item.title: CVE-2024-51567 — CyberPersons CyberPanel
item.description: Threat Signal 87. CyberPanel contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute commands as root.

item.title: CVE-2024-24919 — Check Point Quantum Security Gateways
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Check Point Quantum Security Gateways contain an unspecified information disclosure vulnerability. The vulnerability potentially allows an attacker to access information on Gateways connected to the internet, with IPSec VPN, Remote Access VPN or Mobile Access enabled. This issue affects several product lines from Check Point, including CloudGuard Network, Quantum Scalable Chassis, Quantum Security Gateways, and Quantum Spark Appliances.

item.title: CVE-2023-43208 — NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect
item.description: Threat Signal 87. NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution via a specially crafted request.

item.title: CVE-2024-21762 — Fortinet FortiOS
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Fortinet FortiOS contains an out-of-bound write vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute code or commands via specially crafted HTTP requests.

item.title: CVE-2023-27997 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute code or commands via specifically crafted requests.

item.title: CVE-2019-7194 — QNAP Photo Station
item.description: Threat Signal 87. QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

item.title: CVE-2017-18362 — Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 87. ConnectWise ManagedITSync integration for Kaseya VSA is vulnerable to unauthenticated remote commands that allow full direct access to the Kaseya VSA database.

item.title: CVE-2019-16057 — D-Link DNS-320 Storage Device
item.description: Threat Signal 87. The login_mgr.cgi script in D-Link DNS-320 is vulnerable to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-9822 — DotNetNuke (DNN) DotNetNuke (DNN)
item.description: Threat Signal 87. DotNetNuke (DNN) contains a vulnerability that may allow for remote code execution via cookie deserialization.

item.title: CVE-2021-30116 — Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA) contains an information disclosure vulnerability allowing an attacker to obtain the sessionId that can be used to execute further attacks against the system.

item.title: CVE-2017-0143 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 87. Microsoft Windows Server Message Block 1.0 (SMBv1) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-3992 — VMware ESXi
item.description: Threat Signal 87. VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-21589 — Atlassian Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

item.title: CVE-2026-45659 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2025-8088 — RARLAB WinRAR
item.description: Threat Signal 86. RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting the Windows version of WinRAR. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code by crafting malicious archive files.

item.title: CVE-2024-21412 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 86. Microsoft Windows Internet Shortcut Files contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a security feature bypass.
